metaDescription: Shop custom two tone lanyards for events and ID badges. Bulk pricing available. Request a quote today!
introHtml: Custom two tone lanyards let you combine your brand colors for a professional, coordinated look. Perfect for trade shows, employee IDs, or conference badges, these lanyards use contrasting weaves to create a clean dual-color stripe. Options like the 5/8" Two Ply Polyester Lanyard offer durability and a soft feel, while the 1/2" Polyester Double Bulldog Clip Lanyard provides secure attachment. Choose your two color combination and add your logo via screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for a crisp, lasting imprint.
heroAltText: Custom two tone lanyards in contrasting colors with printed logos and bulldog clips
